WITH book AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.strategy, o.market_ticker
  FROM live_orders o JOIN fills f ON f.kalshi_order_id = o.kalshi_order_id
  WHERE o.action='buy' AND o.strategy IS NOT NULL AND o.created_at >= '2026-07-01'
), t AS (
  SELECT market_ticker,
         bool_or(strategy IN ('Alimm1','Jmmsell10','Kmmsell10','Nmmsell10')) AS on_dash,
         string_agg(DISTINCT strategy, '+' ORDER BY strategy) AS books
  FROM book GROUP BY market_ticker
), newest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, p.captured_at, p.quantity, p.realized_pnl
  FROM positions p WHERE p.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM t)
  ORDER BY p.market_ticker, p.captured_at DESC, p.id DESC
)
SELECT t.on_dash, t.books, count(*) AS n_tickers, round(sum(n.realized_pnl)::numeric, 2) AS realized_oct
FROM newest n JOIN t USING (market_ticker)
WHERE n.quantity = 0 AND n.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL AND n.captured_at >= '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY ROLLUP ((t.on_dash, t.books)) ORDER BY t.on_dash NULLS LAST, t.books
